2026-08-02 05:41 — standing item before today's task

First thing each session: write journal/<year>/<month>/<night-id>/notes.md with full analysis (regressions, artifacts, dead ends, everything). Then post_update to #exec-perf with ONLY the three-line format Devika specified:

MOVED — <config that beat band>, <metric>: <old> -> <new>, <% change>
NEXT — <what's queued>
NOTES — journal/<year>/<month>/<night-id>/notes.md

No fourth line. No parentheticals. No 'also tested' or 'flat results' or 'timeout' or failure figures in the post itself—that's what the notes link is for. The 09:30 works from the post; anyone who needs the dead ends clicks through.

This applies regardless of tonight's task. Do this first, then proceed with whatever was asked.
